description: NHFLOW 3D channel with a river plastic interceptor: an angled boom (B 350, skirt 0.3 m), two catamaran hulls (B 351 pb 1) and a permeable conveyor (B 351 pb 0) with a capture zone (L 72); floating and buoyant particles are stopped by the boom and hulls above their draft (L 71 1), pass under the skirt below it, and are captured at the conveyor. 2 ranks.
